purpose: Engineering visualization of actual generated evaluation meshes; no simulation, checkpoint, or performance measurements

protocol.measurement_window: first wheel projection enters the patch until the last of all four wheels fully clears the opposite edge; keep measuring between axles
protocol.event_sampling: policy-step boundary; each detected boundary may lag the geometric event by up to one policy interval
protocol.success_rule: all four wheels entered through the entry edge and all four trailing wheel edges clear the opposite edge, without failure
protocol.failure_rule: persistent training contact failure, tilt limit, corridor exit, bypass or retreat; failure takes priority over success
protocol.velocity_acceleration: world XYZ velocity and finite-difference acceleration, no filtering, threshold or warmup exclusion
protocol.recording: every control interval and every physics substep inside the measurement window
protocol.physics_inputs: actual applied joint torque and before/after joint angular velocity with physical dt
protocol.distance_inputs: current/previous world XYZ position plus initial goal direction; no fixed terrain-length COT denominator
protocol.online_outputs: raw samples, event rows and event counts; no power/energy/COT/RMSE/VIR/success-rate results
protocol.stair_height_interpretation: per riser: 0.15/0.20 m; 8 levels; center depth/height 1.20/1.60 m

section_method: Exact triangle intersection with local ROI y=3.1 m; preserve vertical faces; round intersection vertices only to 1e-6 m

tiles.profile: flat reference patch and flat surrounding support

generator_metadata.motion: signed world x; negative direction is backward motion
generator_metadata.spawn_alignment: base center on ROI centerline, with bounded xy jitter; whole wheel envelope inside ROI laterally
generator_metadata.legacy_side_argument: left/right are accepted as aliases of center; no wheel-track translation
generator_metadata.outside_support: flat for non-slope tiles; slope x-profile extends across full corridor width, endpoint heights continue over pads and exterior border; tile gaps interpolate edge heights
generator_metadata.transition_note: Concentric stairs have 8 risers per side and return to zero at the ROI edge. Roughness has a zero boundary ring. The slope has no forced return: its high end continues onto an equal-height platform.
generator_metadata.measurement_window: first wheel enters ROI through entry edge until all four wheels leave the opposite edge; includes the gap between front and rear axles

tiles.profile: concentric square terraces from distance to the four ROI edges
